scope: Q8/B0 option B section if_it_were_true only
finding: The counterfactual overstates what follows from the option. Saying acceptance tests are fixed after implementation rules out using those tests to drive the initial implementation test-first. It does not entail that they only describe existing behavior or cannot guide later corrections: tests can encode expected requirements and reveal mismatches after implementation.
conditions_for_original_pass: The original sentence would be defensible only if read with an added restriction that the tests merely document behavior already implemented and are not used to guide any further change. The option does not state that restriction; therefore it cannot support the categorical counterfactual as written.
minimal_section_correction: Тесты, созданные после первоначальной реализации, не направляли бы её test-first; они всё ещё могли бы выявить расхождение с ожиданиями и направить последующие исправления. Поэтому такой подход сам по себе не является ATDD для этой реализации.
other_axes: Not reassessed or changed; this finding is limited to the Q8B counterfactual. The visible option and all repository files remain unchanged.
sources: Logical entailment review against the visible option and ATDD definition/theory in the frozen input; no external fact claim needed.
